title: Femto/Midna historical executable core: critical infrastructure feature contracts
source_scope: Historical normal-layout executable runtime at b19f9d7a; this does not claim current GitHub HEAD has identical runtime. Earlier HEAD-only absence findings are superseded for historical availability.
review_method: Read every line of the eight assigned runtime modules and close adapter, parse AST inventories, trace call sites, read thirteen full test files plus named critical tests from four mixed suites. No archived desk, imports, tests, broker commands, or original production scripts were executed. No app code was edited.
review_limits: Static source review establishes mechanisms and potential gaps; it does not measure live historical impact, execution profitability, paper broker API behavior, or actual scheduler delivery.
Parent review owns remaining runtime modules/operator docs/health/outcomes/journal/snapshot/publishing/context; web_apps owns remaining sleeve runners and their tests.
No strategy, signal formulas, universe, sleeve selection, sizing defaults, risk thresholds, or allocation configuration is transferred to the new zero-strategy desk.
This is operational architecture analysis, not a security assessment.

runtime_classification.core: Deterministic externally invoked paper desk pipeline with synchronous CLI broker calls and status polling.
runtime_classification.callbacks: No asynchronous broker callback handler in these assigned modules; get_order/reconcile_pending and broker snapshots provide completion checks.
runtime_classification.agents: Agent identity and orchestration live outside this core; source must not be described as an LLM execution agent merely because it automates scans.

features.implementable_requirement: Represent schedule invocation, run identity, worker type, deadlines, and completion receipts separately from agent reasoning.
